goal: Add and export the pure domain function summarizeInventory(state) from src/domain/orders.mjs. It must derive { totalUnits, occupiedSkus } from state.stockBySku, work for different states without hardcoded values, preserve every existing operation, and include a focused domain test. Do not change application or api.
acceptanceCriteria: summarizeInventory is exported from the domain module and returns totalUnits as the sum of stockBySku values.
summarizeInventory returns occupiedSkus as the count of positive stock entries and works across different states without hardcoded values.
Existing order and cancellation operations remain unchanged and the focused domain test passes.
